task.title: Create Users in AuditX
task.shortdesc: Create user accounts for team members with role-based access control. AuditX supports four distinct user types: Admin, Custom User, Supervisor, and Operator. Each role has specific permissions and access levels.

ul.li: You must have Admin role in AuditX
You must be logged into the AuditX Forge portal
You can create up to four users per system
You have the user's email address
You have determined the appropriate role for each user

context.p: User creation is an essential step in setting up AuditX for your organization. Each user receives a unique login with role-based permissions that control access to specific features and functions within the system.
context.note: Review the User Roles and Access Control reference document to select the appropriate role for each team member based on their responsibilities.

step.cmd: From the AuditX Forge dashboard, locate the "Users" tab in the left-hand navigation menu
step.info: The Users menu is accessible only to Admin users.

step.cmd: Click the "Add User" button on the right side of the screen
step.info: A user creation form will appear.

step.cmd: Complete the user information form with the following details

substep.cmd: Enter the user's full name in the "User Name" field
Enter the user's email address in the "Email" field
substep.info: This email address is used for login credentials and password reset communications.

substep.cmd: Enter a phone number if applicable

step.cmd: Select the "User Type" from the dropdown menu

ul.li: Admin: Full system access, can create users and configure workflows
Custom User: Sub-admin with limited user creation and device access
Supervisor: Read-only access to dashboards and reports
Operator: Device touchscreen access only for packing operations

step.cmd: Review the selected user type and associated permissions
step.info: A permission summary will display showing what features this user can access with their assigned role.

step.cmd: Click the "Save" button to create the user account
step.info: The system will send an automated password reset email to the user's registered email address.

step.cmd: Verify that the new user appears in your Users list
step.info: The user account is now active and the user can complete their password reset from the email sent by the system.

result.p: The user account has been successfully created. The user will receive an automated email with a password reset link. They can now log in to AuditX with their email address and set their password.

ul.li: User receives password reset email and completes password setup
Assign the user to your site (Assign User to a Site)
Configure the user's access to specific workflows and config groups
Provide the user with device credentials if they need device-level access

dlentry.dd: AuditX supports creating up to four (4) users per system. Additional users may require account plan upgrades.
It is recommended to have at least one additional Admin user as backup for system administration. Have a maximum of 2-3 Admin users.
Multiple Operator accounts can be created for different packing stations. Each operator uses device touchscreen credentials.
Each user must have a unique email address. Shared mailboxes are not recommended for security reasons.
Delete unused users or contact AuditX support to upgrade your account plan for additional user licenses.
Ensure each user has a unique email address. Check for existing accounts using the same email.
Check the user's spam folder or wait 5-10 minutes. You can resend the reset link from the Users management page.
